expectations.text: The rewritten comment keeps the original technical point that querying inside a loop causes an N+1 problem
The rewritten comment explains a concrete consequence (many round trips, latency, load on the database)

expectations.text: The rewritten comment suggests a concrete alternative such as a join, an IN query or batching
expectations.evidence: Single batched query grouped in memory, JOIN alternative.
